itemName.description: Product name as printed, expanded from retailer abbreviations where obvious (KS -> Kirkland Signature, ORG -> Organic, CHKN -> Chicken).

brand.description: Brand only, separate from the product name. Null when the tag shows no brand.

commodity.description: Generic name for what this item IS, with no brand, no size, and no quality claims. Two products that a shopper would consider substitutes must produce the same string. Lowercase, singular where natural. Examples: 'large eggs', 'ground beef 80/20', 'ribeye steak', 'whole milk', 'olive oil', 'paper towels', 'boneless skinless chicken breast'. Be specific enough that the comparison is fair: ribeye is not ground beef.

sizeValue.description: Numeric size of ONE unit in the pack. For '2 x 32 oz' this is 32, not 64. For '24 ct eggs' this is 24 and packCount is 1.

sizeUnit.description: Unit as printed: oz, fl oz, lb, g, kg, ml, l, ct, count, pack, sheets, rolls.

packCount.description: Number of identical units in the pack. For '2 x 32 oz' this is 2. Null or 1 for a single unit.

price.description: Price you pay at the register today, in dollars. If the tag shows a discount, this is the DISCOUNTED price.

regularPrice.description: Pre-discount price in dollars when the tag shows one, e.g. the struck-through price or price + savings. Null if not shown.

savingsAmount.description: Discount amount in dollars when the tag states one, e.g. '$3.00 OFF'.

onSale.description: True when the tag shows any discount, promotion, markdown, or savings block.

saleEndsOn.description: Last day of the promotion as YYYY-MM-DD when the tag prints a date range. Null otherwise.

printedUnitPrice.description: Unit price printed on the tag itself, in dollars, if present. Do not compute it.

printedUnitPriceUnit.description: Unit that printedUnitPrice is per, e.g. 'oz', 'lb', 'ct'.

itemNumber.description: Retailer item/article number printed on the tag.

storeChain.description: Infer from tag layout, logo, fonts, or colors. Costco tags are white with a large black price and an item number; Sam's Club tags carry the Sam's logo; Walmart uses blue or yellow rollback tags; Aldi uses red and blue.

markers.description: Visual markers present on the tag. ASTERISK means a printed asterisk in a corner (Costco discontinuation mark). C_MARKER means a standalone letter C on a Sam's Club sign.

attributes.description: Quality claims printed on the tag. Only include claims actually shown, never inferred from the product type.

rawText.description: All text visible on the tag, in reading order, so rules can match on wording the structured fields drop.

confidence.description: 0 to 1. How confident you are in price and item name specifically. Below 0.7 flags the capture for manual review.

readable.description: False when the image is not a price tag at all, or is too blurred or cropped to read a price.
